Which method is used to produce insoluble salts?
A
addition of excess insoluble base to an acid
B
addition of excess metal to an acid
C
precipitation using two aqueous solutions
D
titration using an acid and an alkali

options.label: A
options.text: addition of excess insoluble base to an acid

options.label: B
options.text: addition of excess metal to an acid

options.label: D
options.text: titration using an acid and an alkali
